question: Which paper reports the best result on ICSI Meeting Recorder Dialog Act Corpus (MRDA) by Accuracy?

lines.question: Which method has the highest Accuracy on the ICSI Meeting Recorder Dialog Act Corpus (MRDA)?
Which papers report Accuracy results on the ICSI Meeting Recorder Dialog Act Corpus (MRDA)?
lines.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?paper WHERE { ?v a ev:Value ; kg:side ?s ; ev:onMetric ?m ; ev:inExperiment ?e . ?m ev:name ?metric . ?e ev:inPaper ?p . ?p ev:name ?paper . VALUES ?s { $sides } VALUES ?metric { $metrics } FILTER(?s = "icsi_mrda") FILTER(?metric = "accuracy") }
how: It looks for every recorded value in the experiments.
It keeps only those values that are measured on the accuracy metric.
It also requires that the value belongs to the specific side of the comparison you selected.
